events.title: President rollback of wildlife habitat protection will affect species globally

The change permits farming, drilling, mining, logging, and development in endangered species habitat without triggering the harm provision, though direct killing remains prohibited.

Weakens U.S. international conservation credibility
Direct killing remains prohibited under law
